about: I am a software engineer with a passion for web development and user-centric design. I pride myself on my ability to learn new technologies quickly and am known to thrive in fast-paced environments. I bring strong attention to detail to every project I work on, emphasizing maintainable, modular, and well-documented code to help provide exceptional experiences to users.

I currently work at Coco Robotics, where I own the frontend development of a wide range of internal and external applications that support business operations. In my free time, I volunteer as a mentor for FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) Team 294, Beach Cities Robotics, teaching high school students about robot programming, strategic analysis, and full-stack development.

description: Manage the design and functionality of 10+ different applications across varying user groups.
Spearheaded the creation of a design system with Shadcn and component management in Storybook.
Added E2E testing with Playwright, integrated with CI to ensure vital functionality is maintained.
Revamped a proprietary warehouse management system to facilitate a growing client and customer base.
Developed the ability for customers to track the progress of their order and access proof of delivery.
Streamlined client billing by developing a cron job and associated user interface for generating invoices.
Improved reliability with third-party integrations such as Shopify, Route4Me, Twilio, SendGrid, and Clerk.
Designed and developed tools for online technology designed specifically for the Deaf community.
Created a content management system to simplify using video content across different projects.
Created a cutting-edge platform for making and distributing surveys in American Sign Language (ASL).
Used WCAG 2.2 design guidelines and color indicators and standards for non-text contrast from USWDS.
Conducted an unmoderated user study with 30 Deaf participants to evaluate the tool's usability.
Developed a data override system integrated into an internal portal for managing Medicaid claims.
Reduced DevOps costs by empowering users to submit manual data corrections and receive approvals.

projects.title: Warehouse Management System
projects.description: Manage all operations of a same-day sustainable delivery company. It provides an easy way to track and edit orders, configure vendors, update inventory, and manage billing. Vendors have their own dashboard to view all of their recent deliveries. Customers can use their tracking number to see the order status and proof of delivery. Its features utilize integrations with Shopify, Route4Me, Twilio, SendGrid, and Clerk.

projects.title: ASL Survey Tool
projects.description: Create and distribute surveys in American Sign Language, relying entirely on videos and non-English elements. The design incorporates color indicators that meet WCAG 2.2 and USWDS standards for non-text contrast. To evaluate the tool's usability, we conducted an unmoderated user study with 30 Deaf participants. It was used at the Symposium on AI and Sign Language Interpreting in April 2024 for entry and exit surveys.
